text: Cenomi Centers' annual report for 2025 lists FAS Real Estate Company Limited as its largest shareholder, with 26.89% of its capital as of 31 December 2025; the report's consolidated financial statements (note 14.B.i) state that Saudi FAS Holding Company is the ultimate parent of the company, via its immediate parent company FAS Real Estate Company Limited.
short: FAS Real Estate (26.89%) is Cenomi Centers' largest shareholder; Saudi FAS Holding is the ultimate parent

source.name: Cenomi Centers: Annual Report 2025 (archived copy of centers.cenomi.com PDF; substantial-shareholdings table, Tadawul records as of 31/12/2025, and consolidated financial statements note 14.B.i)
source.note: The same report's related-party note (14.B.i) states: 'Saudi FAS Holding Company is the ultimate parent of the Company via assignment of shares by the Company's immediate parent company (FAS Real Estate Company Limited)'.
